component.$description: Component tokens: measurements specific to one component, exposed as CSS variables named --<component>-<property> (the 'component.' prefix is dropped). Values come from the final Figma screens and the Preline tokens they resolve to (research 08c, 08d, 08f).

menu-padding.$description: The sidebar opened as the small-screen menu (Figma drawer frames: 24).

account-height.$description: The account chip: one line and the edit pencil (Figma 248x40).

profile-height.$description: The account chip with a second line or an avatar (the player team card, Figma 248x54).

item-height.$description: A navigation item: the highlighted link, on the full sidebar and the collapsed rail (Figma Item:margin 248x48 around a 240x46 link).

item-padding-x-collapsed.$description: Centres the 20 px icon in the 46 px item of the collapsed rail.

sub-item-gap.$description: Between sub items (Figma pitch 42 for 36 px items).

sub-list-gap.$description: Between the divider and the sub items (Preline Navigations/Sidebar/List/Sub Dropdown Gap Between).

divider-width.$description: The vertical rule beside a sub list (Preline Navigations/Sidebar/List/Divider Width).

padding-y.$description: The player's KPI bar (Navbar Variant2 2097:161669): 8 above and below, 16 at the sides.

gap.$description: From the KPIs to the energy pill and Submit.

column-gap.$description: The least room between two KPIs of the two-row bar; they spread apart when it is wider (Figma: 27 at 1172 px, 92 at 1366).

row-height.$description: A row of KPIs (Figma rows 31 tall at y 0 and 52).

row-gap.$description: Each side of the white line between the two rows.

action-width.$description: The energy pill and Submit, from 640 px (the desktop bar and the tablet top bar).

action-width-phone.$description: The energy pill and Submit in the phone top bar (1370:60522).

delta-width.$description: The slot of a KPI's change badge, so the values line up.

delta-zero-bg.$description: An unchanged KPI's badge (0%), and one without a figure (N/A).

fold-padding-y.$description: Below 1024 px: the Winning Metrics row, 12 above and below (Figma phone 1370:61191).

tablet-padding-y.$description: From 1024 px: the two rows of chips, centred in Figma's 108 px bar (1369:59214: 12, and 6 more either side).

chip-gap.$description: Between the chips on tablets and phones.

group-gap.$description: Under Winning Metrics: 16 from the company's figures to the line under them, and 16 after the 8 px gap before the segment's (the sheet 1370:60541).

energy-over-bg.$description: The energy pill when the decisions cost more energy than is left (today's; Figma draws no such state).

panel-padding.$description: The player's 'Set Your Strategy Inputs' panel: slate 100, radius 16, 20 inside, the title 16 above the rows (Figma Frame 38752).

panel-width.$description: The panel beside the product's charts on a desktop page (Figma: 640 fixed, the charts filling the rest).

row-gap.$description: From a decision row's line to the next row (Figma rows 830:87100).

row-padding.$description: Under a row's content, to its line: Figma's 12, which draws the 1 px line inside it (a number row is 78 tall, a slider row 117).

text-width.$description: A decision's title chip and description.

field-gap.$description: At least this between the text and a field; the field sits at the end.

slider-width.$description: A slider, its ticks and its chips (Figma 832:92216).

label-bg.$description: The chip behind a decision's title.

label-width.$description: A decision's title and caption when it has a column per sub-product (Figma's ShopLink and GrowthLab rows, 2709:179069).

columns-width.$description: A decision's columns share this (Figma 2709:179099): three of 174 or two of 285.5, 49 apart.

column-gutter.$description: Each side of the 1 px line between two columns.

header-padding.$description: Under a section's header, to its line: Figma's 16, which draws the 1 px line inside it (2709:179051).

tile-min-width.$description: A tile at least: Figma's Training tile (870:34335), and 16, the figures, 32, today's narrowest field and 16. A narrower card puts fewer tiles in a row.

tile-gap.$description: Between a tile's figures, its field or slider, and its chips.

tile-field-min-width.$description: A tile's field at least (today's 105); with less room it goes under the figures.

figures-width.$description: The read-only figures beside a tile's field (Figma 864:34269).

padding.$description: The frame around a slide deck (Figma slides viewer, 3344:153504): white, a black 16% edge, 12 px corners, 20 inside.

gap.$description: From the slide to Previous, the slide's number and Next under it.

slide-width.$description: The size a slide is laid out at (Figma's 16:9 card, 3344:153505). It grows to fit the frame, or the screen in full screen; on a computer it never shrinks below it, on a phone it fits the width.

slide-gap.$description: Between a slide's title, its content and its footer.

content-max-width.$description: Inner column of a 1440 frame (1140 to 1150 in Figma).

height.$description: The frame's height: the window's. An app that zooms its page (CSS zoom scales viewport units with it) sets it to fill the window again, as calc(100dvh / zoom).

radius-container.$description: Large containers: statement cards, login card, round detail.
